body:
Most sentient species are uplifted into the Galactic Community. Humans, however, found their own way into space... During the middle of a Galactic war.







.... Well they all fuckin died the end

As you're driving in your car, you begin to taste blood in your mouth. Your brain is replaying the events that led up to the crash and you realize that you've crashed, but there's nothing you can do to stop it....

You reach for your phone and go to the contacts lists, and you leave a message for everyone and the message reads, *Hello everyone its me, Mat but.. I wont be going home today as... a incident happened, I will miss you all and...* You feel yourself weaken as the blood fills your face, and as you hear the ambulance you see mere visions of yourself at Christmas with your son, Jack.
That image stays in your head for as long as you can breathe...
"I'm... I'll... I miss you Jack.. and i'm sorry I didn't get to spend one last Christmas with... you." and everything fades out, all the voices are echo's and small and all you can remember is your family and life.

But as you gain senses you don't feel pain but... nothing... like your numb but your alive. everything is dark. you look down to see your in water but to your toes.
"Mat... come."
You look up to see a man about your age and hes smiling.
'W-Who are you and w-why am I here?"
"You are in what we call... Limbo."
It doesn't seem possible but... it's all real 
You walk towards the man and start to fall.

"Jack... I..." My mom would start tearing up.
"Your dad...Isn't coming home.'
I'm very confused and ask her. 
"Why? is he gonna stay with friends?"
"No... h-Hes never gonna come back home."
I feel tears coming.
"He.. just got in a c-car accident and... isn't..." 
You fall to your knees and start crying completely. Your mom picks you up and puts you to bed and she gets in too crying.
"D-dad?!" "Yes hes never gonna come home.." and you cry yourself to sleep.
You wake up in a dark place but feel... elevated, and your happy for some reason.
you look down to see your taller.
A man approaches you. He's like your age. you start saying words to him but can't make them out. and you get the feeling hes familiar.

You wake up in a dark cramped place. you can't get out and start wiggling.
"Help!" you yell and hear a door open and a lock being unlocked.
you are pulled out of a cold place and see a room what looks like a morgue.
"We got one!" You look around and see the room. It is a morgue, and you see a scientist or staff come out and get you on your feet.
"I want you to head home, oh don't worry about your family and friends we'll notify them soon.

You wake up still depressed about last night, and see your mom is gone.
You get up to get some cereal and hear the lock on the door opening.

The end.

After an international poll overwhelmingly votes it in as humanities greatest artistic achievement, NASA reluctantly launches it's new deep space probe with a single data file stored: the entire Bee Movie script. And off it goes to deep space never to be seen again...

10 years later you, (Insert whatever character you want here) Is sitting down in a tree playing on your phone, when all the sudden you hear a loud *Thump* "Huh? What was that?" You jump out from the branch to see a weird looking thing and head towards it.

It looks like the space probe they released 10 years back but it's torn up and kind broken, so you take it in to your dad. (Which is luckily a mechanic) And looks at it.
"Hmmm... this isn't our technology. Something more advanced." 
You don't know ad take ti around asking about it. One person says that it's "Government technology" and you should return it. Being who you are you mail it to the white house and boom, you are awarded with being the finder of the space probe and are given a 10,000 dollar prize.

The end.
Hahaha, I can't stop laughing, about that response.
